text:
Predicates:
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Writer(x, y) ::: x is a y writer.
Born(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Written(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Premises:
¬Novel(podcast) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (Born(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ∀y (Novel(y) ∧ Written(y, x) → Writer(x, novel)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro, writer) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
Written(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(familyHistory) ::: Family History is a novel.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ∧ Podcast(familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
City(boston) ∧ American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
Writer(daniShapiro, novel) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
